candidates.title: RobotAgentBench: Towards Open-world Robot Autonomy
candidates.reason: Paper, author project identity and open-world task taxonomy checked; full methods, five-dimension protocols and any result rows need original-table and release-level audit before admission.

candidates.title: VLA-HWBench: Where the Time Goes When VLA Models Run on Edge Hardware
candidates.reason: Edge hardware inference breakdown is scientifically relevant; latency and platform-specific optimizations must not be converted into policy success rates. Full tables not yet independently read.

candidates.title: TRIAGE: Efficient Vision-Language-Action Inference Needs Both Reuse and Pruning
candidates.reason: Cache validity and token pruning mechanisms are relevant. Abstract-level Jetson prefill timing, success and action error are not verified against full tables/protocols; defer results.

candidates.title: RynnVLA-Latent: Scaling Robotic Manipulation Foundation Models with 3D-Grounded Latent Actions
candidates.reason: New latent-action pretraining and cross-embodiment result candidate. First verify original training mixture, LIBERO/Plus/VLABench/RoboTwin evaluation scopes, methods, reported baselines and project resource availability.

candidates.title: X-World: Transferring Video Priors to Variable-View Robot Control
candidates.reason: Video-prior transfer, multi-view observations and asynchronous action execution candidate; full read must separate LIBERO, LIBERO-Plus, six real tasks and negative camera/background/noise shift details.

candidates.title: SWAP: Stepwise Action Policy Routing for Vision-Language-Action Models
candidates.reason: Older candidate surfaced through one indexed OpenAlex work, title/authors/arXiv matched. Status only 'under review for ICRA 2027', NOT accepted; no full methods/results read yet.
